name: Thermal management
description: Boards with devices dissipating more than about 0.5 W or operating hot.
placement_rules: Hot parts spread; heat-sensitive parts (references, electrolytics, sensors) away from them
routing_rules: Wide copper to spread heat from power pads
copper_rules: Copper area per watt from device datasheets; thermal vias to the opposite side
verification_requirements: Junction temperature per device at max ambient recorded with the thermal-resistance source
